运行代码
async () => {
  // 在 V2EX 帖子页验证最新回复是否包含目标文本
  const replies = [...document.querySelectorAll('[id^="reply_content_"], .reply_content')].map(el => el.textContent.trim());
  const last = replies[replies.length - 1] || null;
  const countEl = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(el => el.children.length === 0 && /条回复/.test(el.textContent));
  const anchor = document.querySelector('#reply5, [id="r5"]');
  return {
    ok: true,
    url: location.href,
    replyCount: replies.length,
    lastReply: last ? last.slice(0, 100) : null,
    containsTarget: replies.some(t => t.includes('我能评论帖子 - 发送自轻舟')),
    headerText: countEl ? countEl.textContent.trim() : null,
    anchorFound: !!anchor
  };
}
